lua: CAM = require('lib.camera'); DRIVE = function(x, z, tx, tz) local h = math.atan(tx - x, tz - z); local v = nova.named('van'); v:teleport(x, z, h); local s = nova.scene_now(); s.mode = 'van'; v.driven = true; v.engine_on = true; nova.named('postmaster').seated = true; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(h) end; WALK = function(px, pz, tx, tz) local s = nova.scene_now(); s.mode = 'foot'; local p = nova.named('postmaster'); p.seated = false; local h = math.atan(tx - px, tz - pz); p.x, p.z, p.face = px, pz, h; CAM.pinned = nil; CAM.reset(h); nova.named('van'):teleport(6.5, -177, 0) end; CLOSE = function(kind, k, dist, up, look, fov, off) local n = 0; for _, o in ipairs(nova.scene_data('valley').objects) do if o.kind == kind then n = n + 1; if n == k then local ry = (o.props and o.props.ry) or 0; local fx, fz = math.sin(ry), math.cos(ry); local ox = off or 0; AT(o.x + fx * dist + fz * ox, up, o.z + fz * dist - fx * ox, o.x, look, o.z, fov or 50); return end end end end; SHEET = function(kinds, x0, z0, sp, dist, fov) local n = #kinds; for i, k in ipairs(kinds) do local x = x0 + (i - 1) * sp; nova.scenery.add(k, x, 0, z0, { ry = 0 }); if k == 'washing_line' then nova.scenery.add('cloths', x, 1.3, z0, { ry = 0 }) end end; local cx = x0 + (n - 1) * sp / 2; AT(cx, 2.2, z0 + dist, cx, 0.7, z0, fov or 40) end; AT = function(ex, ey, ez, tx, ty, tz, fov) CAM.pinned = { ex, nova.terrain_height(ex, ez) + ey, ez, tx, nova.terrain_height(tx, tz) + ty, tz, fov or 50 } end
